name: code-block
title: Code Block
description: Code or command output built from the library's own parts: a ghost icon Button with a Tooltip whose copy icon crossfades to a check that draws itself, and the ScrollArea scrollbar with scroll-fade edges. Line numbers, wrapping and a height cap. Ships no highlighter: pass highlighted markup as children and the plain string stays what gets copied.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/code-block. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#code-block.
